title: Remote nodes
description: Manage SSH connections and choose where new tasks run.
defaultHelp: Applies to new tasks. An offline or disabled default stays selected until you change it.
empty: No remote nodes yet. Add an SSH connection to get started.
loadError: Could not read the current configuration. Reload nodes before making another change.
operationError: The change could not be confirmed. The current configuration has been reloaded; review it before retrying.
pollPaused: Automatic refresh paused after one minute. Reload to continue observing the installation or connection check.
keepCredential: A credential is saved. Leave this field empty to keep it.
keepPassphrase: Leave empty to keep the saved passphrase, or explicitly remove it below.
credentialHelp: Credentials are sent to the desktop service and cleared from this form after submission.
verifyFingerprint: Verify this fingerprint with your server administrator before trusting it. Confirm only if you recognise this server.

installationError.runner_release_unavailable: The matching runner package is unavailable. Install the required package and retry.
installationError.runner_release_upgrade_required: The runner needs an upgrade. Retry installation with the current runner package.
installationError.runner_release_integrity_failed: Runner package verification failed. Replace the package and retry.
installationError.runner_upgrade_required: The runner version is incompatible. Upgrade the runner before starting a task.
installationError.runner_installation_failed: Runner installation failed. Check the connection and retry installation.
installationError.installation_root_required: Installation needs an SSH account with root privileges. Edit the connection and retry.
installationError.unsupported_installation_platform: This server platform is not supported by the runner installer.
installationError.installation_busy: An installation is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
installationError.installation_operation_conflict: The installation operation changed. Reload the node and retry.
installationError.installation_path_not_owned: The installer cannot use the existing server installation. Review the server installation before retrying.
installationError.node_pairing_repair_required: Runner pairing needs repair. Verify the server and retry installation.
installationError.installation_integrity_failed: Runner verification failed. Check the package and retry installation.
installationError.invalid_installation_request: The installation request is invalid. Review the node configuration and retry.
installationError.unknown: Installation could not finish. Check the connection and retry installation.

upgrade.title: Runner upgrade
upgrade.help: Explicitly pause admission, back up data and switch Runner. A different client build never starts an upgrade automatically.
upgrade.busy: Tasks remain: {{active}} active, {{queued}} queued, {{pending}} pending. Upgrading will not cancel them. Wait for completion and check the connection again.
upgrade.unconfirmed: The server has not confirmed this operation. Its identity is retained while status is read. Retry this operation after the connection recovers.
upgrade.resumeAttempted: Admission resume has been attempted. Restoring the old database is blocked to protect any new data.
upgrade.background: The desktop service continues the upgrade when this panel closes. Reopen it to read durable progress.
upgrade.commandError: The command result could not be confirmed. The same operation is retained; read its status before retrying.
upgrade.readError: Upgrade status could not be read. The operation is retained; read again or retry this operation.
upgrade.missingOperation: The original upgrade record could not be read. Its identity is retained. Check desktop logs and read again before proceeding.

error.runner_release_unavailable: The upgrade package is unavailable. Prepare the matching release and retry this operation.
error.invalid_runner_release: The upgrade release is invalid. Update the application release and retry this operation.
error.runner_release_upgrade_required: This release cannot perform the required upgrade. Update the application and retry this operation.
error.runner_release_integrity_failed: The release package failed verification. Replace it and retry this operation.
error.remote_connection_failed: The server connection failed. Restore connectivity and retry this operation.
error.remote_file_integrity_failed: The uploaded package failed verification. Retry this operation with the verified package.
error.installation_root_required: The SSH account needs root privileges for this upgrade. Verify its permissions before retrying.
error.unsupported_installation_platform: This server platform does not support the upgrade procedure.
error.installation_busy: The server is busy with tasks or another operation. Wait, then retry this operation.
error.installation_busy_maintenance: The node remains in maintenance while accepted tasks continue. Wait for them to finish, then retry this upgrade or restore when available. Tasks are not cancelled.
error.installation_operation_conflict: The server operation differs from the expected upgrade. Read its status before proceeding.
error.installation_path_not_owned: The installed program is not owned by this upgrade procedure. Inspect the server installation before proceeding.
error.node_pairing_repair_required: Runner pairing must be repaired. Verify the server identity before proceeding.
error.runner_upgrade_required: The Runner needs a supported upgrade release. Update the desktop application and retry this operation.
error.installation_integrity_failed: Runner verification failed. Read the operation state and retry or restore when available.
error.invalid_installation_request: The upgrade request is invalid. Read the current node and operation state before proceeding.
error.runner_installation_failed: The upgrade could not finish. Read its state and retry or restore when available.
error.unknown: The upgrade reported an unrecognised error. Read its state and check desktop logs before proceeding.

upgrade.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the build ID to copy it manually.

scheduling.label: Concurrent tasks
scheduling.help: 1–128 tasks, shared by the entire node. Changes apply immediately and persist. Request concurrency within tasks still shares the node's total budget.
scheduling.busy: {{active}} tasks are running. Wait for tasks to finish before lowering this limit.

errors.remote_node_identity_conflict: The upgrade identity differs from the expected operation or Runner. This node is locked; read its state before proceeding.
errors.remote_nodes_unavailable: Remote node management is unavailable. Reopen the desktop application and try again.
errors.remote_node_invalid: Check the node settings and authentication, then save again.
errors.remote_node_revision_conflict: This configuration changed elsewhere. The current settings have been reloaded; review them before retrying.
errors.remote_node_not_found: The node no longer exists. Review the refreshed node list.
errors.remote_node_re_pair_required: This change requires pairing the runner again. Verify its identity and retry installation.
errors.remote_node_still_referenced: This node is still used by tasks or is the default. Change the default and resolve task references before removing it.
errors.remote_node_usage_unavailable: Task references could not be checked. The node has been kept; retry later.
errors.remote_node_credential_unavailable: The saved credential is unavailable. Edit the node and enter the credential again.
errors.remote_node_busy: The node is busy. Wait for its current operation to finish and retry.
errors.remote_node_commit_unconfirmed: The save result is uncertain. Review the refreshed configuration before saving again.
errors.remote_node_upgrade_required: Upgrade or reinstall the runner before using this node.
